---

## What you're trying to do

A one-sentence description of your end goal. (E.g. "Integrate FBT Car-Operating-Cost into our payroll system's year-end FBT module.")

## What you've tried

- Which docs you've read (`README.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/CONTRACT.md`, `docs/OPERATIONAL.md`).
- Which example you've run.
- Any code you've written so far (a minimal reproducible snippet is ideal).

## What you're stuck on

The specific blocker. Could be:
- The docs don't cover your case.
- An example doesn't work the way you expected.
- You're getting an unexpected response shape.
- You're unsure how to map your customer's input to the calculator's input schema.

## Environment

- Kit version: `vX.Y.Z`
- Client language + version (e.g. `.NET 8`, `Python 3.11`, `Node 20`)
- OS (e.g. `Windows 11`, `Ubuntu 22.04`, `macOS 14`)
- Calculator URN(s) you're working with
- Period URN(s) you're working with

## Expected response time

We triage integration questions within one working day. If your question reveals a documentation gap, we ship a doc delta along with the response.
